dragonsworn.snatched: The dragon has you in its talons!
dragonsworn.seized: The dragon has you in its jaws!
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dragonswo: An overhauled Ender Dragon: a new animated boss model whose wings fold like a fan and carry it on the ground.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.dragonswo: An overhauled Ender Dragon: a new animated boss model whose wings fold like a fan and carry it on the ground.
commands.dragonsworn.anim.forced: Every dragon now loops '%s'. '/dragonsworn anim auto' to undo.
dragonsworn.config.title: Dragonsworn: dragon AI
dragonsworn.config.remote: You are on a server: these are your local settings; the server's own config file decides its dragons.
dragonsworn.config.section.wandering.too: A wild dragon with nothing to hunt roams: long spells on foot, short flights between them.
dragonsworn.config.section.stance.toolti: A wild dragon fights on foot; hurt too much there it takes a break in the air, then comes back down.
dragonsworn.config.section.crowd.tooltip: The more players fight it, the fiercer it gets: its attacks come sooner, and players bunched together draw its area attacks (breath, fireballs, the wing buffet).
dragonsworn.config.section.ground_combat: Fighting on its feet: bite, tail strike, roar, the seize (a bite that holds on), narrow footholds.
dragonsworn.config.section.climbing.tool: Walls: it flies in and grips a cliff, a spire or a pillar where its feet find a block to stand on, for a short while, to reach prey there or hiding in tunnels dug into it; then it flies off again.
dragonsworn.config.section.air_combat.to: A wild dragon's attacks from the air, and when it lands to fight instead.
dragonsworn.config.section.attacks.toolt: Which air attacks exist at all. A disabled attack is never used, not even as a fallback.
dragonsworn.config.section.attacks.open_: How a target on open ground (room to land beside it) is attacked from the air: the odds of each attack being the first choice (relative weights). If the first choice cannot start (no line of sight, prey too big to carry...) the attacks listed after it are tried in this order. 0 = never the first choice.
As above, for a target the dragon cannot land beside (a wall's top, a pillar, a ledge).
dragonsworn.config.section.attacks.air.t: As above, for a target in the air (elytra, creative flight, a drop under it).
dragonsworn.config.section.snatch.toolti: The snatch: a dive that grabs the prey in its talons, a climb, and a drop.
dragonsworn.config.section.fireballs.too: The fireball pass and the hovering barrage.
dragonsworn.config.section.flyby_bite.to: The fly-by bite: a bite in passing, harder the faster it flies.
dragonsworn.config.section.hover_attacks: Hovering in close to bite or breathe.
dragonsworn.config.section.breath.toolti: The void-flame breath (perched stream, breath pass, hovering breath) and the fire it leaves.
dragonsworn.config.section.arena.tooltip: The End fight's dragon: vanilla's fight, plus landings beside players and air attacks.
dragonsworn.config.section.end_island.to: The End island's shape and its crystals' wards (worldgen; the respawn ritual rebuilds the spires the same way).
dragonsworn.config.section.other_mods.to: Other mods that reshape the End or run their own End fight: Stellarity, YUNG's Better End Island, BetterEnd, Nullscape. Each piece can come from either: the island and its pillars, the crystals (wards), the dragon.
dragonsworn.config.section.spells.toolti: With Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks: the dragon now and then counters a player's spell (Counterspell).
dragonsworn.config.option.dragon.max_hea: Health points (2 = one heart), on every difficulty: 500 as the Warden (vanilla's dragon has 200).
dragonsworn.config.option.targeting.hunt: Blocks: a wild dragon hunts survival players this close (0 = it only fights back).
dragonsworn.config.option.targeting.forg: Blocks: whoever hurt a wild dragon is chased until this far away.
dragonsworn.config.option.targeting.wake: Blocks: a dragon resting on the ground wakes for a player this close.
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.flig: Ticks (20 = 1 s) a roaming flight lasts before it looks for somewhere to land: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.grou: Ticks it stays on foot (walking, resting) before it flies again: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.paus: Ticks it stands and looks around between walks: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.fly_: Blocks per leg of a roaming flight: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.crui: Blocks over the ground it cruises at: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.wandering.drif: Degrees each new leg (walk or flight) may turn from the last. Low: it travels on; high: it stays round one spot.
dragonsworn.config.option.stance.ground_: Fraction of its max health lost on the ground that sends it up for a break in the air (1 = never).
dragonsworn.config.option.stance.air_hea: Fraction of its max health lost during the break that brings it back down early.
dragonsworn.config.option.stance.break_m: Ticks a break in the air lasts (attacking from there): at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.stance.calm_ti: Ticks without a target after which it calms down: the next fight starts on the ground again.
dragonsworn.config.option.stance.overwhe: Take off when hit too many times at once on the ground (from its blind spots). Any dragon, the End's too.
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.range.to: Blocks from the dragon a survival player counts toward the crowd it fights.
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.pace_per: Each player past the first speeds up its attacks by this much (0.35: against two, the pauses between attacks run 1.35 times as fast; 0 = off).
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.max_pace: Its attacks come at most this many times as fast as against one player.
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.guard_pa: The End's dragon with a player at its crystals: its attacks come at least this many times as fast (1 = no faster).
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.group_ra: Blocks: players this close to the one it attacks count as bunched together with it.
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.area_bia: Each player bunched with its target makes an area attack (breath pass, hovering breath, fireballs) this much likelier to be its first choice (1: twice as likely with two players, three times with three; 0 = off).
dragonsworn.config.option.crowd.mob_buff: On the ground: that many players within its wing buffet's reach get the buffet before any bite or tail strike (0 = never).
Bite what is in front of it.
Lash its tail at what is beside or behind it.
Roar at a target out of reach while nobody is close: slows everything in its range (whoever runs away or shoots from afar).
Beat both wings at what is too close to bite or lash (under its chin, at its flanks, behind its hips): it throws everything round its body away.
Bites may hold on: the prey is shaken, chewed and flung.
Come down on a ledge or a pillar's top beside its prey (sat up, or clinging) where all four feet do not fit.
A target to its side, nearer the head than the tail: the chance it bites rather than lashes its tail.
Ticks after a bite before the next blow.
Ticks after a tail strike before the next blow.
Ticks after a wing buffet before the next blow.
Ticks before a bite or tail strike lands that its aim is committed: the window to step out of the way.
Blocks: it roars only at a target closer than this, and the roar slows everything this close.
Blocks: it roars only while no target is this close (one in reach gets a blow instead).
Ticks the roar slows whoever it reaches.
Ticks a hit counts: hurt from behind this recently, it answers with its tail instead of turning round.
The chance a bite is a seize.
Ticks after a seize before the next can be.
Ticks the jaws hold their prey: at least ...
Ticks between chews of the prey held.
Blocks: how close the jaws must come to a body to hit it (standing and hovering bites).
Blocks from its middle the wing buffet reaches (and a target this close in a blind spot gets it).
How hard the wing buffet throws what it hits away (blocks a tick).
Damage of the bite that seizes.
Blocks: a target this far off (or 10 blocks above or below) ...
... for this many ticks is given up: it takes off.
Ticks its prey may stay out of its jaws' reach while it is on a narrow foothold before it takes off.
Ticks its prey may stay out of reach of its blows (up a pillar, across a ditch) while it cannot walk any closer before it takes off to fight from the air.
Ticks it clings to a pillar's top at most.
The End's dragon: ticks it stays on the ground once landed: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.climb: Climb: grip walls it flies to (wall_landing), hop onto ledges and down off them, reach prey hiding in tunnels.
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.wall_: Fly in and grip a wall beside prey it cannot land by (on a cliff, a spire's flank, in a tunnel's mouth).
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.hop_r: Blocks: the furthest it hops across the ground (onto a ledge, down off one).
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.hop_p: Ticks its prey may stay out of reach while it cannot walk any closer before it looks for a hop toward it.
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.tunne: Blocks: how far into a tunnel too narrow for its head its bite reaches past the mouth.
Pour its breath down a tunnel its prey hides in beyond its bite.
Ticks after a breath down a tunnel before the next.
dragonsworn.config.option.climbing.wall_: Ticks it stays on a wall with nobody to fight.
Ticks it stays on a wall at most, fighting or not, before it flies off again.
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.lan: A wild dragon lands beside its target to fight it on foot. Off: it fights only from the air.
Ticks between tries to land beside its target (attacks from the air in between).
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.fir: Ticks after it appears before its first air attack.
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.ear: Ticks between air attacks on a break in the air, or at a target it cannot land by: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.cas: Ticks between air attacks while it would rather land and fight on foot: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.air: Blocks of air under a target that make it a target in the air.
dragonsworn.config.option.air_combat.wal: Ticks a target it found no landing beside counts as out of reach on the ground.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.snatch: Dive and carry off the prey in its talons, then drop it.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.breath: A gliding pass raking the ground with void flame.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.fireba: A low run at the target with one fireball.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.charge: Vanilla's charge: straight at the target.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.barrag: Hovers off to one side and fires several fireballs.
dragonsworn.config.option.attacks.hover_: Hovers and breathes void flame at the target.
dragonsworn.config.weight.tooltip: Relative weight of this attack being the first choice (0 = never first).
dragonsworn.config.option.snatch.drop_he: Blocks over where it caught its prey that it drops it: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.flyby_bite.bas: Damage of a fly-by bite at a standstill ...
dragonsworn.config.option.flyby_bite.spe: ... plus this per block/tick of its speed (it flies at about 0.9..1.3) ...
dragonsworn.config.option.flyby_bite.rad: Blocks: how close the jaws must come to a body to hit it.
Bites in one hovering attack, at most.
Damage of the hovering breath (every 10 ticks a target stays in it).
dragonsworn.config.option.breath.perched: Perched, after its roar: the chance it pours the void-flame stream rather than vanilla's lingering breath cloud.
dragonsworn.config.option.breath.streams: Streams per perch; after the last it takes off.
dragonsworn.config.option.breath.stream_: Damage of the perched stream (every 10 ticks a target stays in it).
dragonsworn.config.option.breath.pass_da: Damage of the breath pass (every 4 ticks a target stays in it).
dragonsworn.config.option.breath.dragon_: Fire attacks (breath, fireballs, the perched cloud) leave dragon fire where they land. It burns out by itself and never spreads.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.ground_a: Now and then it lands beside a player on the island to fight on foot.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.guard_cr: It guards its crystals: it goes after the player nearest a crystal (and nearest itself) first, one at a time, and comes sooner.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.guard_ra: Blocks from a crystal a player counts as a threat to it.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.guard_dr: Picking whom to go after: how much nearness to the dragon counts, against nearness to a crystal (0 = the crystals alone).
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.guard_sw: Blocks nearer a crystal another player must be to draw it off the one it is after.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.guard_re: Ticks before it goes at a player threatening its crystals again.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.perch_fi: Perched and hit by someone close, it gets up and fights them on foot rather than sitting still.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.snatch_c: When it goes for a player on the ground: the chance of a snatch instead of a landing ...
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.first_as: Ticks after it appears before it first goes for a player.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.retry.to: Ticks before it looks again when nobody could be attacked.
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.after_la: Ticks after a landing to fight before the next, while crystals stand: at least ...
The same, once the crystals are gone: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.after_pa: Ticks after a snatch or breath pass: at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.after_ai: Ticks after an air attack on a player it cannot land by (in the air, up a spire): at least ...
dragonsworn.config.option.arena.island_r: Blocks from the fight's center a player counts as on the island (perches and assaults go only there).
dragonsworn.config.option.end_island.spi: Spiral obsidian spires in place of the island's obsidian pillars (crystals stay where the pillars put them). Off: vanilla's pillars, or a datapack's (Stellarity's). YUNG's Better End Island and BetterEnd always build their own.
dragonsworn.config.option.end_island.ent: The spherical obsidian arrival platform in place of vanilla's flat one.
dragonsworn.config.option.end_island.war: Crystals warded by three turning rings of runes (projectiles bounce off them; break them up close) on Easy and Peaceful: those on the shortest spires, the ones vanilla cages (0 = none) ...
Ward the crystals on pillars Dragonsworn did not build too (vanilla's with the spires off, Stellarity's, YUNG's Better End Island's, BetterEnd's), as the End fight finds them.
dragonsworn.config.option.other_mods.isl: Where a datapack moves the crystal pillars (Stellarity), the End fight finds them there: it counts and wards their crystals and rebuilds the pillars there on a respawn, not at vanilla's places.
dragonsworn.config.option.other_mods.ste: With Stellarity: its own End fight (its dragon's attacks, boss bars, respawn ritual and portal), Dragonsworn only drawing its dragon. Off: Stellarity's fight is switched off and vanilla's dragon fights on its island, with Dragonsworn's AI, crystals and respawn.
dragonsworn.config.option.spells.counter: Counter a spell a survival player starts casting in its sight: the spell fizzles and goes on cooldown, and the player's magic effects end, as with Counterspell.
Chance it counters a spell it could counter (0 = never, 1 = every one).
Ticks (20 = 1 s) after a counter before it can counter again.
Blocks: it counters spells cast this close to it.
subtitles.dragonsworn.entity.ender_drago: Ender Dragon buffets with its wings
